title: Engine Off: My 2026 Hackathon Run Is Over
why_read: A personal reflection on participating in dev hackathons and challenges throughout the year, with little concrete technical detail about any specific project.
analysis: This post is a retrospective on the author's year of entering developer competitions and hackathons, discussing motivation and the experience of winning and losing rather than technical implementation details. It mentions building apps inspired by word association and SDK challenges, but doesn't go into how anything was actually built. It reads more as a personal blog entry about competitive hackathon culture than as a technical resource for engineers.
